title: Waveforms, Sampling Rate & Aliasing
interviewAnswer: Digital audio samples a continuous waveform at a fixed rate. Frequencies above the Nyquist limit cannot be represented correctly and can alias, so preprocessing and resampling need appropriate filtering.
keyPoints: Nyquist frequency is half sample rate.
why: Waveforms, Sampling Rate & Aliasing appears frequently in data-science work because it connects mathematical assumptions to practical decisions, diagnostics and failure modes.
deepDive: Digital audio samples a continuous waveform at a fixed rate.
